reviews.author: todd stevanus
reviews.text: They did a fantastic job of pouring a concrete pad for me. Very professional, and attention to detail and clean up after the job was very much appreciated. I look forward to using them for other jobs in the future.

reviews.author: Christopher Klein
reviews.text: Dustin and his Team were fantastic. They were able to take on a challenging waterfront property including clearing, hauling, grading, rip-rap, seed, straw, silt fence, driveway and more. Truely a turnkey outfit. Thank you and Great Job!

reviews.author: Aaron Porter
reviews.text: The level of customer care and awareness during the process of clearing our land was so excellent, it garnered additional work! The level of professionalism, promptness were something new to me in a build. Not expected, but highly appreciated. From our contact down to the works out in the field- outstanding.

reviews.author: Sarah Whitley
reviews.text: J.A. Baker has just finished clearing our land in Macon, NC. The service was exceptional. The owner and his crew were professional from the initial quote to the completion of the project. We are very pleased with their work.

reviews.author: Pat Coe
reviews.text: Great business. I've been dealing with Barker Construction for 20+ years. They cleared my land 23 years ago where I put my house. Even though I'm just a home owner, they did a great job pouring my concrete sidewalk and patio, and the occasional load of gravel for the driveway, they always make me feel like an important customer. All the staff are great to deal with, and are always willing to get what I need in a timely manner.

reviews.author: Ginny Beck
reviews.text: I always get my truck inspected here. Everyone is very nice. They try to take you right away when you get there. You never have to worry about being a woman and going to a mechanic and getting screwed, they take good care of you and you can count on the work to be done right.

reviews.author: Roger Romer
reviews.text: All my experiences with Barker Construction have been a pleasure. Grading, Land Clearing, Vehicle inspection. Best in South Hill

reviews.author: Christy Taylor
reviews.text: Great company to work with. Provides timely and fair work estimates. Keeps customer informed on job status. Reasonably priced for superb work.

reviews.author: HistoryBuff57
reviews.text: I have been getting my vehicles inspection done here for about the last 10 - 15 years or more. The folks here are always friendly and very professional.

reviews.author: Mark Barbosa
reviews.text: I've dealt with this company a couple of times and they are always a good value. Their equipment operators are very seasoned experts at what they do.

reviews.author: Karen MardenAlcombright
reviews.text: Highly recommend ja Barker! They were able to spread the loads of millings.. very little left to do.

reviews.author: Dustin
reviews.text: Family Business that treats customers like part of that family. Customer service is always the #1 goal.
